description: This file implements initialization, support check, and unload functions for a COSA plugin, including registration of various parameter handling functions.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers backend API functions, and checks version support.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Returns whether a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Performs cleanup and unloads the plugin.
